subject: DataCove workspace bootstrap & access sequencing
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@datacove.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@datacove.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DataCove workspace bootstrap & access sequencing

Hi Liam / Elena —

Great to kick this off. Attached is a short checklist (datacove-onboarding-checklist.xlsx) with the steps we typically run for a clean first-week bootstrap. Proposed high-level plan:

1) Create org and primary project: datacove-prod (ops-managed)
2) Seed 3 admin accounts and 2 service accounts (ingest + metrics)
3) Generate initial API keys and provide a secure seed script for your infra team
4) Optional: KMS/HSM integration and short-lived tokens for ingestion (> recommended for regulated data)
5) Invite cadence: admins now, devs after basic calls + role mapping document

Questions for you before kickoff:
- Confirm the three admin emails to seed (names/emails)
- Do you want long-lived API keys (created and rotated by you) or short-lived tokens + agent seeding (Redwood can seed ephemeral keys during handoff)?
- Any SSO (SAML/Okta) or SCIM automation planned in week 1?

Next step: 30–40 minute technical kickoff. I have availability Mon 10/20 10:00–11:00 PT or Tue 10/21 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works for your team?

Attachments: datacove-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — looking forward.

Jonas Weber
Principal CSM, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference | Production-first LLM inference for engineering teams

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@datacove.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@datacove.com>, procurement@datacove.com
Date: Sun, 19 Oct 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DataCove workspace bootstrap & access sequencing

Thanks Jonas —

Appreciate the checklist. Quick answers:
- We can seed the three admins: liam.oconnor@datacove.com, elena.ruiz@datacove.com, nate.murphy@datacove.com
- We'd prefer short-lived tokens for ingestion if Redwood supports a smooth refresh flow. Procurement will want a note on key rotation/retention in the SOW.
- We do plan to onboard via Okta (SAML). SCIM is on the roadmap but not required for initial week.

Kickoff: Tue 10/21 14:00–14:40 PT works best for the team. I'll invite our infra lead and security lead.

-Liam
Head of Platform, DataCove
liam.oconnor@datacove.com

Subject: Re: DataCove workspace bootstrap & access sequencing

Thanks — Tue 10/21 14:00 PT booked. Calendar invite sent to your infra/security leads. Quick update on the plan and what we'll actually do during the 40-minute call: 

Agenda (40 min):
- 5m introductions & success criteria (what does "done" look like?)
- 10m access model: admin vs dev vs service accounts; project naming conventions
- 15m API key and seeding options (demo short-lived token flow + seeding script)
- 5m KMS/rotation considerations + follow-ups (SOW / procurement ask)
- 5m next steps & deliverables

Deliverables to complete in week 1 (post-kickoff):
- Create datacove-prod project and seed three admin accounts (Redwood will create and email one-time setup links)
- Create one ingest service account + one metrics service account and hand off seeding script (datacove-project-roles.csv attached)
- Provide a short playbook for token rotation and recommended schedule (we'll include in SOW appendix)
- Draft SOW delivered for procurement review (sending redwood-sow-draft.pdf by EOD Monday)

If you confirm the admin list above I'll ask Ben to prepare the seeding script and Laura to add the SAML checklist to the kickoff doc. For short-lived tokens: we'll demo a refresh flow that issues 1-hour tokens backed by a long-lived service credential that you keep in KMS. That keeps secrets out of CI while letting your agents refresh automatically.

Attachments: datacove-project-roles.csv

Jonas
Principal CSM, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Oct 2025 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: DataCove workspace bootstrap & access sequencing

Folks — quick internal checklist before kickoff (short and actionable):

- Ben: prepare seeding script that accepts CSV with (email, role, initial_admin_flag). Include an option to output a rotation plan (cron-friendly).
- Laura: add SAML Okta configuration steps + SCIM note (defer for week 2). Add step to hand off instructions for their security lead on KMS encryption at rest.
- Jonas: confirm whether we should create the two service accounts as long-lived + recommend a rotation cadence in the SOW draft. I'll review the SOW and mark any procurement items.

I'll be on the kickoff to handle role mapping and to walk through the invite cadence. We should be ready to seed keys during or immediately after the call so DataCove can run a smoke test (ingest a small payload).

--
Monica Patel
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
